name: Annaliese Koell
source: The quiet sort, Annaliese is always listening to music on her questionably expensive headphones. What genre she listens to the most has yet to be figured out, as she tends to avoid people in general. Her preference for baggy clothing is to maximize comfort and to keep her bundled up while at school.
